description: This file defines a TestBrowser class for managing browser contexts and a loginByAPI function for user authentication and session storage, used in end-to-end testing with Playwright in the Mattermost project.

classes.name: TestBrowser
classes.description: A class to manage Playwright browser contexts, including login and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in a user by creating a new browser context with stored session data and returns various page objects.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all active browser contexts managed by the TestBrowser instance.

methods.name: loginByAPI
methods.description: Performs user login via API, saves session state to a file, and returns the storage state file path.
